style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;fontColor=#8c8f98;fontSize=11;fontFamily=IBM Plex Sans;spacing=0;" value="A job is accepted once, by a unique key on the accepted-jobs row, then published. The reconciler republishes only rows with no publish receipt, so a crash between insert and publish loses nothing. Each (tenant, class) has its own small queue and the controller pulls with credit, so the broker never orders across tenants. Admission starts the workflow with an id derived from (tenant, key): an id that already exists is acked and dropped. Only intake messages that cannot be processed reach the DLQ." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="56" width="920" x="20" y="610" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div: A job is accepted once, by a unique key on the accepted-jobs row, then published. The reconciler republishes only rows with no publish receipt, so a crash between insert and publish loses nothing. Each (tenant, class) has its own small queue and the controller pulls with credit, so the broker never orders across tenants. Admission starts the workflow with an id derived from (tenant, key): an id that already exists is acked and dropped. Only intake messages that cannot be processed reach the DLQ.
